descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S05 UAT walk, Hospital: yesterday's visit and today's visit on one patient; open the panel, expand each entry

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 The physician can open Prior Encounter Transcripts for a patient, and the prior encounters are listed there automatically. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 How it works 2; TFA-92594 AC 2)
  • U3 Entries display collapsed, each with a line count, and the line count is accurate. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 AC 3; TFA-92594 How it works 3)
  • U4 Expanding a collapsed entry shows the correct full transcript: that visit's lines for that patient, all of them, and nothing from another entry. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 AC 4; TFA-92594 How it works 4)
  • T2 Collapsed rows are labelled accurately (e.g. 'Most Recent'), so each row says which encounter it is. (TFA-92594 AC 3; TFA-92594 How it works 3)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given {hospitalPatient} with a 3-line bedside recording yesterday and a 2-line recording today. Two rounding.update writes are seeded so the server's own archive rule builds the '(prior)' row

When Open the chart's Encounter tab and look at Prior Encounter Transcripts without opening anything; open the '(prior)' row; then open 'Most Recent'

Then Two collapsed rows: '<yesterday> (prior)' with 3 lines and 'Most Recent' with 2 lines. The prior row expands to yesterday's three lines with Physician / Patient labels and times. Opening Most Recent shows today's lines and closes yesterday's

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs. cp1 (collapsed): mustContain '(prior)', '3 lines', 'Most Recent', '2 lines' and mustNotContain the Y lines (U3, T2). cp2: mustContain all three Y lines and '09:13 AM' (Y2's time; today's lines are 08:40 / 08:41) (U4). 'Physician' and 'Patient' are not checked: oracle.mjs matches case-insensitive substrings, Recorded Transcript renders today's lines with the same la …

Where it ran: dev unit U26; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
